title: Lara Ricote: GRL/LATNX/DEF
overview: Lara's a small Latin American girl (woman?) who won the Funny Women 2021 (right, 'woman') Stage Award and is now doing her first hour about what it's like to be Latin and deaf and a girl who's now a woman at the same time.  This show won best newcomer at the ed fringe 2022 if that means something to you. It starts kinda bad but it gets better as it goes along SO JUST give it a little bit of time!!!
